name: temps
description: Install, connect and operate your self-hosted Temps deployment platform from Claude.
long_description:
Temps is a self-hosted deployment platform: deployments, managed databases, domains and TLS, analytics, error tracking and observability in a single binary.

This extension works before you have an instance: ask Claude how to install Temps on this computer, on a server you already have, or on a new one, and it walks you through the exact steps.

Once Temps is running, enter its console URL and an API key in the extension settings and Claude can read your projects, deployments, logs and services through the same commands as the Temps CLI. Write tools are off by default; when you enable them, Claude can propose changes such as a deployment, and each one still needs your confirmation.

The extension only talks to the Temps instance you configure. Your API key is stored in the operating system's keychain and is never shown to Claude.

tools.name: temps_write
tools.description: Propose a change on your Temps instance (write tools only; shown to you before it runs)

tools.name: confirm_action
tools.description: Run a proposed change after your approval (write tools only)

temps_url.title: Temps console URL
temps_url.description: The address of your Temps console, e.g. https://temps.example.com. Leave empty until Temps is installed: Claude can guide you through installing it.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: Create one in the console under Settings → API Keys. A read-only key is enough unless you enable write tools.

enable_write_tools.title: Allow write tools
enable_write_tools.description: Let Claude propose deployments. Each one still needs your confirmation, and the API key must have deployment access.
